prompts.terrain: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original transparent terrain material sprite atlas for ORDRE DE CENDRE, painterly semi-realistic 2D side-scrolling industrial science-fiction game. This atlas belongs to THYR: a humid forest valley of massive fibrous tree columns, cultivated clearings and woven suspended homes, subdued forest greens, violet-brown organic soils and filtered diffuse canopy light. Create exactly FOUR flat broad rectangular material samples in strict TWO columns and TWO rows, wide landscape 2:1 sheet. Strict FRONT VIEW of a vertical exposed soil section, no isometric or top-down perspective, no visible top surface. TOP LEFT: dark damp humus, muted deep green-brown with tiny decomposed leaf flecks and fine organic grain. TOP RIGHT: compact violet-brown clay with thin hairlike fibrous inclusions, quiet horizontal compressed layers, NO projecting or arching large roots. BOTTOM LEFT: gray-green wet shale, fine subdued moss staining and small horizontal fractures. BOTTOM RIGHT: layered dark peat, fine packed plant fibres and gentle mauve-brown horizontal stratification. Every swatch is a completely filled rectangular flat material field, opaque inside, no holes, no silhouettes, no scenery or ground plane. Almost straight top and bottom edges and vertical sides. Each patch roughly twice as wide as high, separated by broad clear transparent gutters and outer margins at least 40 pixels. Fine detailed painterly game texture, moderate contrast, matte natural finish, diffuse light, no shine, no neon or magic glow, no thick black outline. Genuine PNG alpha transparency everywhere outside the four rectangles. No grass growing above edges, no giant roots, no trees, no animals, no eggs, no mushrooms, no homes, no characters, no water, no metal, no text, numbers, captions, labels, grid lines, border, watermark, cast shadows or painted checkerboard. EXACTLY FOUR material cells. Original science-fiction world, no recognizable franchise art.

TOP ROW left to right: 1 a low broad rounded grey-green stone capped with a little soft dark moss; 2 a flat scatter of five fallen muted violet-brown and olive leaves, completely detached dry leaf litter without stems; 3 a short horizontal broken piece of dead fibrous bark, low hollow half-shell with jagged end, no tree stump or arch. BOTTOM ROW left to right: 4 a very small low ground fern with six curled rounded fronds spreading sideways, no tall stalk, no cups, no sacs, no membranes or flowers; 5 a cluster of three dry fallen open woody seed-pod husks with a few tiny seeds visible, irregular matte brown wood, clearly broken plant fragments not eggs or a nest; 6 a low flat pebble with pale grey-green crust lichen across the top, no glow. These are tiny decorative ground accents only, never giant living roots, living support columns, breathing membrane vines or tall tubular echo grass. Entire cutouts wholly inside their cells, at least 40 transparent pixels clear on every side, all shapes low and grounded. No scenic background, no connecting floor patch, no cast shadow, no ambient glow or haze. Fine painterly material detail and readable restrained silhouettes; coherent matte diffuse upper-left light matching a forest game panorama. True transparent PNG alpha around and between all six cutouts.
